rejected_quality: Half moment storage failed moving-edge stress.

experiments.native_half_rounding_fix: The retained code uses asuint16(half(value)); all measured retained runs use the corrected integrated shader.

limits: Target 1.48 ms has not been achieved. The smaller verified gain is retained.

findings: Shared row padding regressed on the retained 320-thread configuration.

Guide polynomial approximations and factoring common powers across exposure brackets passed their initial desktop gates, but short-run gains were only about 0.002-0.004 ms; not promoted without stronger evidence.
Explicit RGB texel loads regressed; unrolling improved that candidate substantially but it remained slower than Gather.
Omitting the finest residual Laplacian failed colored-edge, HDR and motion gates; rejected.
continuation_screen.counter_probe: perfetto --query exposes android.gpu.memory but no gpu.counters data source on this device; no hardware busy/bandwidth measurements obtained.
continuation_screen.next_direction: Wave-local coarse pyramid tail: the first coarse level of a 16x8 tail has at most 32 pixels. Investigate keeping those levels in registers and reducing workgroup rendezvous, with subgroup mapping guards and the existing fallback.

findings: A register/shuffle coarse tail passed the initial desktop and phone image gates but gave no full-chain speedup.
A 32-thread legacy tail was slower than the retained tail.

Shared-memory tail rewrites produced non-finite intermediates on the phone; full-workgroup control variants also failed, so subgroup synchronization has not been isolated as the cause. They are rejected and their timings are not performance evidence.
A wrapper-only legacy control remained correct. The rewrite issue remains confined to ignored experimental shaders.
wave_tail_screen.next_direction: Evaluate emitting FP32 guide/EV moments directly from fused reconstruction and consuming them with bilinear 5x5 integration in Guided. Validate numerical stability and account for the additional intermediate bandwidth; keep the current path as control.
